subject: Interview tonight — need to cancel / option for recorded exercise
messages:
From: Liam Hart <liam.hart@example.com>

Cc: Pegasus Talent <talent@pegasusrecruiting.com>
Date: 2028-07-18T07:05:00-07:00
Subject: Last-minute — really sorry, can't make tonight

Hi Soojin,

I apologize for the late note — I woke up with a pretty nasty bout of gastritis and my doctor advised I stay home and rest. I won't be in any shape for the interview this evening at 6pm PT. I'm really excited about the role and hate to miss this slot.

If possible, I'd like to (a) switch to whatever recorded coding exercise you can provide and submit within a short window, or (b) reschedule to later this week. I can do mornings (8–11am PT) on Thursday and Friday if that helps.

Sorry again for the short notice and thank you for being flexible.

— Liam Hart
liam.hart@example.com
(555) 212-0910

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Last-minute — really sorry, can't make tonight

Hi Liam —

Thanks for the heads up and I hope you feel better soon. We have two options that should work and keep things moving:

1) Recorded coding exercise (preferred): I attached a short instructions PDF and an async consent note. If you take this route, please try to submit within 72 hours but let me know if you need an extension. We'll have the panel review asynchronously and get back with results and any live follow-ups.

2) Reschedule: we have availability Thursday 9am–11am PT or Friday 8:30–10am PT. If you prefer a live slot, tell me the best window and I'll confirm with the panel.

If you pick the recorded exercise, we'll convert tonight's panel to an async review and treat your submission the same as the live work sample. Otherwise I can lock a new live slot.

Attached: recorded-exercise-instructions.pdf (pdf), async-eval-consent.txt (txt)

Quick note to the panel: Marissa/Rishi/Jasmine — FYI, candidate reached out to cancel for illness; if he goes async we should plan for a short follow-up Q&A (15–20m) once we've reviewed.

— Soojin Lee

Thanks Soojin — I appreciate the quick response and the options.

I'll take the recorded exercise. Quick question: I was started on an antacid earlier this morning and I'm moving slower than usual — would it be possible to get a 5-day window to complete the exercise instead of 72 hours? I want to make sure I can give a clean submission rather than a rushed one tonight.

If 5 days is too long, I can aim for 72 hours and push through, but I'd rather not submit low quality work.

— Liam

Hi Liam —

No problem, that's totally fine. Please take up to 5 days (by 2028-07-23T23:59:00-07:00) to submit the recorded exercise. We'll mark the panel's timeline accordingly. If anything changes on your end and you want a live slot instead, let us know and we'll try to reschedule to Thursday or Friday morning.

Next steps for clarity: 
- You have the exercise instructions in the Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExampleInstructions
- Consent file attached (async-eval-consent.txt) — confirm by replying that you agree to an async review.
- Submit via a private repo link or a zipped folder to soojin_lee@redwood.com; include any notes and runtime instructions.
- Panel will do an async review; Marissa will collate notes and we'll schedule a short 15–20m live follow-up only if needed.

Feel better and thanks for the quick communication.
